alt_text: 1:1 MENTORSHIP — Your reel isn't weak. It's unfocused.

captions.linkedin:
Nobody gets rejected for having too few shots. They get rejected for having the wrong ones.

A reel with 3 strong shots beats a reel with 9 average ones, every single time. Recruiters stop watching in 12 seconds.

In mentorship I go through your reel the way a lead would: what stays, what gets cut, what gets rebuilt, and in what order - so you stop spending months polishing shots that were never going to land you the job.

Book the free demo and bring your current reel.

→ Get your reel reviewed: https://mythicalmotions.com/mentorship
→ AnimBelt (Maya toolkit): https://mythicalmotions.com/animbelt
→ Everything else: https://mythicalmotions.com
→ Free animator Discord: https://discord.gg/suMy2Z7CHa
